certification.name: Certified Red Teamer
certification.description: Five-hour practical exam on Windows red team operations, starting from low-privileged domain credentials and requiring privilege escalation and lateral movement. Taken online and on demand; the certificate does not expire.
certification.currency_note: Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 250); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); frequent promotional discounts; one free retake included
